verdict.rationale: Okta's SSO docs describe authenticating once via an IdP to reach all connected apps (okta-docs-1, okta-docs-8), and a community comment confirms the existence of Okta's browser (Chrome) plugin used alongside the dashboard (okta-comm-12), supporting the launcher/browser-extension story. However, there is no first-party documentation in the pack specifically describing the End-User Dashboard UI, app assignment/tile experience, or browser extension features/setup — missing for 10: dedicated end-user dashboard docs, browser extension feature details, and independent hands-on validation of the single-portal experience beyond a passing mention.
